description: Source code for DPDK-based Ethernet frame receiver and transmitter classes, including start/stop control, frame reception, and transmission logic, as well as a factory function to create a transceiver object.

classes.name: ru_emu_dpdk_receiver
classes.description: Class handling DPDK Ethernet frame reception, including start, stop, and receive loop management.

classes.name: ru_emu_dpdk_transmitter
classes.description: Class responsible for transmitting frames via DPDK.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the DPDK Ethernet frame receiver, setting up asynchronous execution and signaling readiness.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Requests stopping of the receiver and waits until it is fully stopped.

methods.name: receive_loop
methods.description: Main loop for receiving frames, with retry logic if deferring fails.

methods.name: receive
methods.description: Receives a burst of frames from DPDK, processes each frame, and notifies via callback.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Transmits a span of frames, handling buffer allocation, appending data, and managing transmission failures.
